notes.title: Presidential Rise is Featured on Steam’s Political Sim Fest! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Hello Presidents,[/p][p]I’m super excited to share some great news — [i]Presidential Rise[/i] is now featured on Steam’s [b]Political Sim Fest[/b] section! 🚀  Seeing the game highlighted there (and watching the wishlist count grow) has been really motivating. Thank you so much for the support and all the feedback you’ve shared — it truly helps me keep pushing forward as a solo developer. 💙 [/p][p]Over the past weeks, I’ve been working hard on new content and features. Here’s a quick look at what’s coming next:[/p][list][*][p]🏗️ [b]Upgrade Mechanic[/b] – You’ll be able to upgrade your infrastructure to make it more efficient and bring greater benefits to your nation.[/p][/*][*][p]📖 [b]More Story[/b] – The president will face real threats from enemies, adding more depth and tension to the journey.[/p][/*][*][p]👥 [b]New Animations[/b] – Your presidential office will feel more alive, with more people gathering around and interacting in the environment.[/p][/*][/list][p]Here’s a little sneak peek of the progress so far 👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/3e494a9e057479e91f71bf972dbcd821f898b57f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/7deaf3c91e8308148d711c0eb2bca0fc94e40a86.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/b59a21a9579e4a4b7e61cef03c61a81b0277f094.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/78a687ec34a34f58825370a7c89a0831e7c9ebd9.png"][/img][/p][p]I’d also love to hear more of your ideas and feedback!
You can share them in the [b]Discussion tab[/b] right here on Steam, or through this feedback form:
👉 [/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfrzvNDpQCLyL9xWz19jKUbcxEB5jNXd7wXHJT33vVQqxUENw/viewform"]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfrzvNDpQCLyL9xWz19jKUbcxEB5jNXd7wXHJT33vVQqxUENw/viewform[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Your input really shapes the direction of [i]Presidential Rise[/i].

And if you haven’t tried the [b]demo[/b] yet — now’s the perfect time! You can play it right here on the Steam page.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561950/Presidential_Rise_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you again for all the support — don’t forget to hit that [b]Wishlist[/b] button if you haven’t already. Every wishlist helps a lot and keeps me motivated to make this game the best it can be.
[/p][p]Until next time,
– Getty, solo dev of [i]Presidential Rise[/i][/p]

notes.title: We’re officially partnering with indie.io!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/8037d59bb201cc79bedc89c3a80001bb344adfc9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone! I’m thrilled to officially announce that [b]Presidential Rise[/b] is now partnering with the amazing team at [b]indie.io[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]As a solo developer, this is a huge milestone for me. I’ve spent the past two years pouring my heart into Presidential Rise, a political simulation management game that blends strategy, storytelling, and reflection. I’ve always loved games that let me think deeply but enjoy them at my own pace, and I wanted to create something meaningful that others could enjoy the same way.[/p][p][/p][p]With no prior experience in the game industry, I knew I needed support to help shape this game into something even more polished and discoverable. That’s when I found indie.io. Their approach was incredibly friendly and welcoming especially for someone like me, navigating this industry alone. They believe in walking alongside developers, and that’s exactly the kind of partnership I was hoping for.[/p][p][/p][p]For those who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like [b]indie.io[/b] greatly helps indie developers focus on creating while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From managing store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and showcasing games at events, they help games reach the players they were made for.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m so excited for what’s to come, and I can’t wait to share more with you soon.[/p][p][/p][h3]👉 Don’t forget to [b]wishlist and follow Presidential Rise[/b]![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926700/Presidential_Rise/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And while you’re here, check out [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"]indie.io’s Publisher Page[/url] to discover other awesome indie titles they’re supporting.[/p][p]Thanks so much for being a part of this journey with me. [/p][p]– Getty (Ilusif Studio)[/p]

notes.title: A Tough Lesson, a Valuable Fix – Demo Now Playable!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to sincerely thank all of you who took the time to try the demo, even though many of you were unfortunately unable to start a new game due to a persistent bug. After spending quite a bit of time chasing down the issue, I’m happy to let you know that it has finally been fixed.

Initially, I suspected the problem was related to the save system specifically the file path used to write JSON data. When that didn’t solve it, I rebuilt the system using PlayerPrefs instead, but the problem still remained.

Looking back now, I realize I made a classic newbie mistake: I didn’t check the logs. While juggling this game and my full-time job, I was trying to fix the issue based on assumptions. This is my first game, and it’s been a tough but valuable learning experience. As it turns out, the entire problem was caused by a single missing variable.

Unfortunately, that small mistake cost the game its initial first impression during release, which is heartbreaking. But I truly hope the game is still worth playing now that it’s working as intended. If you run into any further issues, please don’t hesitate to let me know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/d89a4ad7ce1136df56adbe069eeec4e90cb72412.png[/img]

Thank you again for your patience, support, and understanding. Wishing you all the best and I hope you enjoy the demo!

[i]P.S. This game was created solo, so every bit of feedback truly means a lot.[/i]

notes.title: Presidential Rise Demo Is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm the solo developer behind Presidential Rise, and today I want to share a little story about this journey, about the game, and why I’m so excited to finally release its demo on Steam.

It all started with a casual moment. As a programmer, I was playing some strategy games and thought,
"Hey, I think I could make a game like this…" and since I’ve always loved this kind of genre, I decided to give it a shot. I started learning Unity, UI/UX, storytelling, gameplay design, even game marketing. It was a slow process at first I also work full-time but every bit of free time I had, I poured into this project.
Piece by piece, I built it on my own (well… with some help from AI too 😄).

Honestly, throughout this development journey, I discovered something I’ve never felt before: a sense of freedom, creativity, and something that truly feels like me.

Through this game, I’m expressing a vision that came straight from my mind and heart and now I get to share it with the world.

I know it’s not perfect. But I’m incredibly proud that what started as a random idea has grown into something real. Presidential Rise now has a Steam page and a playable demo. For me, that’s already a huge milestone and I hope you can feel the passion I’ve poured into this game.


[h3]About the Game[/h3]
In Presidential Rise, you take the role of the president of a rising nation.
Your mission? Balance the economy, implement policies, and maintain your popularity.

Manage citizen requests, pass laws, fight corruption, and grow your country all while navigating political pressure that isn’t always in your control. Every decision has consequences. Can you lead your nation to prosperity?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/7a6e8ef86d8729084b4c6690919766f475006923.gif[/img]


[h3]Demo Available Now![/h3]
You can now play the demo version directly on Steam! This is just the beginning a glimpse into the bigger vision I have for this game. I’d love to hear what you think, and your feedback will mean the world as I continue development.


[h3]Support the Game with a Wishlist![/h3]
If you like the concept and where it’s going, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist. That really helps to spread the word and support the future of the game.

👉 [Play the Demo](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926700/Presidential_Rise)  
👉 [Add to Wishlist](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561950/Presidential_Rise_Demo/)


If you’ve read this far thank you for being part of this journey.
See you in Presidential Rise!
